display_name: Tata Motors LP 410 (face-cowl bus chassis) 3400 WB
sources_note: Imported from the research handover by tools/import_handover.js. CONFIRMED = official OEM or government document; ESTIMATED = planning value, derived figure or non-official source; UNKNOWN = not found (value null). Interior dimensions are design estimates, not measurements (data/handover/rv_handover_part1_models_data_research/data/interior_confidence_report.md).

length.source: BusesDekho (aggregator) Tata LP 410 specifications, https://buses.cardekho.com/buses/tata/lp-410/specifications (captured 8 Oct 2026 in donors.json 'tata-lp410-3400'; not an OEM source)

width.source: BusesDekho (aggregator) Tata LP 410 specifications, https://buses.cardekho.com/buses/tata/lp-410/specifications (captured 8 Oct 2026 in donors.json 'tata-lp410-3400'; not an OEM source)

height.method: Concept body height (donors.json proposedBody, ±300 mm). No OEM body exists; chassis height is not the body height.

wheelbase.source: BusesDekho (aggregator) Tata LP 410 specifications, https://buses.cardekho.com/buses/tata/lp-410/specifications (captured 8 Oct 2026 in donors.json 'tata-lp410-3400'; not an OEM source)
wheelbase.method: Aggregator figure only. Tata OEM chassis pages found on 21 Nov 2026 are LP 410/31, /33, /36 (search results suggest about 3100/3300/3500 mm wheelbases); no OEM 3400 mm card was found. See open_questions.md

seating_as_sold.source: BusesDekho (aggregator) Tata LP 410 specifications, https://buses.cardekho.com/buses/tata/lp-410/specifications (captured 8 Oct 2026 in donors.json 'tata-lp410-3400'; not an OEM source)

seats_as_sold_max.source: Incomplete chassis: seating depends on the body builder

category_as_sold.value: Incomplete bus chassis (as sold). A completed passenger bus above 5 t GVW would be M3.
category_as_sold.source: AIS-053 cl. 3.1.1.2 / 3.1.1.3 and IS 14272:2011 cl. 3.1.1 (rules/official_pdfs/) applied to the GVW above
category_as_sold.method: Rule applied by the packager; not an OEM category label

emission_standard.source: No OEM card for the 3400 mm wheelbase; one aggregator listing reportedly says BS-III (handover open question 15)

availability.source: Handover open question 15: Tata lists LP 410/31, /33, /36 chassis; the 3400 mm wheelbase card was not found and may not be current

leads.source: TrucksBuses Tata LP 410 price band (aggregator), https://www.trucksbuses.com/buses/chassis/school-staff/tata-lp-410/price, via donors.json (read 8 Oct 2026)

living_x0_from_rear.method: Living area starts 40 mm wall + 20 mm inside the rear face (xr = xB + t + 0.02)

usable_length.method: GLB living length: from 60 mm inside the rear wall to 360 mm behind the cab-seat backs (cab length estimated: vans 1650–1800 ±250 mm, buses 2100–2600 ±300 mm). Not a measurement.

usable_width.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
usable_width.method: Exterior width 2140 − 2 × 40 mm assumed wall (donors.json shellWallEachSideMm 40 ±15). No taper, trim or tumblehome allowed for.

standing_height.method: GLB living-area clear height = overall height 2800 − estimated floor 900 − 40 mm roof skin − 20 mm (build_camper.py: zc = H − t − 0.02)

floor_height.source: research/project_files/donors.json (ObjectWeave seed 2026-10-08); models/source/vehicles.py (GLB build input, 19 Nov 2026)
floor_height.method: Not published. Planning default from donors.json (vans 560 ±100 mm, Wider Body 580) / concept floor for bus bodies (LP 410 900 ±150, Eicher 950 ±150, Viking 1000 ±200)

wheel_arch.note: Interior intrusion is NOT modelled in the GLB layouts (the arches are cut only in the body side walls). Values below are donors.json planning defaults, not measurements.

intrusion_from_each_side_wall.method: donors.json planning default interior.wheelArchIntrusionMm (tyre size known, housing not)

side.method: Kerb (left) side, as modelled in the GLB

from_front.method: Converted from the handover x-from-front-axle: front overhang − x

to_front.method: Converted from the handover x-from-front-axle: front overhang − x

height.method: GLB placeholder: from sill to 150 mm below roof

glb.origin: Mid-length of the body, on the centreline, at ground level. NOT the front axle and NOT the repo origin (rear bumper). Repo x (mm from rear bumper) = (glb_x_m + L/2) × 1000.
glb.layout_as_built: fixed rear transverse double bed 2060x1400 mm over a storage garage; wet room with cassette toilet, shower tray and washbasin; kitchenette 1300 mm with 2-burner cooktop and sink, 12 V fridge; dinette 1700x1300 mm (2 facing benches + removable table, converts to a 2nd bed); tall wardrobe; overhead lockers; water tank 173 L, 1 x 100 Ah LiFePO4 battery + panel, 230 V shore inlet, 2 x 2 kg extinguishers (driver + kitchen/door)
